subject.title: Feishu card action: pass through form_value, input_value and other fields

question: What Feishu card-action payload contract should OpenClaw expose for callback fields that are siblings of `action.value`?
rationale: The field-loss bug is source-proven, but the permanent agent-visible payload format is a plugin behavior contract and affects existing command/button semantics.

options.title: Structured Additive Payload
options.body: Forward `action.value` plus `form_value`, `input_value`, `name`, `option`, and `options` as structured JSON only when extra callback fields are present, while leaving simple button text and command behavior unchanged.

options.title: Command-Text Append
options.body: Append selected callback fields to the legacy command string, which is smaller but can be ambiguous for arbitrary form keys and values.

options.title: Typed Contract First
options.body: Pause the fix until maintainers define a broader typed card-action contract for Feishu and any sibling channel plugins.

recommendation.title: Structured Additive Payload
recommendation.body: Forward `action.value` plus `form_value`, `input_value`, `name`, `option`, and `options` as structured JSON only when extra callback fields are present, while leaving simple button text and command behavior unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: The package metadata names this handle as the Feishu plugin community-maintained contact, so they are the best available owner for the channel-specific payload contract choice.
